ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, ABCD is a rectangle, A is at the upper left, B is at the lower left, C is at the lower right, D is at the upper right; a diagonal is drawn from A to C, and another diagonal BD is also drawn in the figure. At vertex A, diagonal AC divides the right angle of the rectangle into two labeled angles: between AD and AC is (4x+5)°, and between AC and AB is (9x+20)°. Reasoning: Because ABCD is a rectangle, ∠DAB = 90°. These two angles add up to ∠DAB, therefore (4x+5)+(9x+20)=90. Simplifying gives 13x+25=90, so 13x=65, x=5.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a rectangle ABCD with diagonal AC drawn from A to C. At vertex A, the diagonal AC splits the right angle DAB into two labeled angles: (4x+5)° between AD and AC, and (9x+20)° between AC and AB. Use the text statement that ABCD is a rectangle, so angle DAB is 90°. Set (4x+5)+(9x+20)=90 and solve to get 13x+25=90, hence x=5.
